hero.title: Website. Catalog. Automation.
hero.lead: See your website first — for free. A clickable prototype of your homepage in 48–72 hours.

items.title: You paid — and you wait for months
items.text: The prepayment is gone, the website isn't there. Deadlines slip, replies come once a week.

items.title: No idea what you'll get
items.text: You pay upfront and see the result only at the end. And it's nothing like you imagined.

items.title: Every edit goes through a developer
items.text: To change a price or a phone number you have to ask someone and wait. Or pay again.

items.title: A website, but no leads
items.text: It looks nice, but clients don't call. And it's unclear what to do about it.

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: We learn about your business, your clients and the goal of the site.
steps.details: A short 20–30 minute call. We ask in plain words: what you do, who your clients are, what the website should do. We write the spec ourselves — you don't need to prepare anything.

steps.title: Research
steps.text: We study your competitors and niche to find what makes you stand out.
steps.details: We look at competitors' websites — what works and what doesn't. We find what makes you different, so clients choose you.

steps.title: Free prototype
steps.text: In 48–72 hours you see your website. Like it — we go on.
steps.details: We build a clickable prototype of the homepage: open it on your phone, scroll, tap the buttons. It's free and you owe us nothing.

steps.title: Moodboard
steps.text: We agree on the style: colours, fonts, mood.
steps.details: We show a selection of colours, fonts and examples. You pick what feels right, so the design hits the mark from the start.

steps.title: Design
steps.text: First 2 screens, then the whole site in the approved style.
steps.details: We design two key screens first and approve them with you. Then the rest of the site in the same style. No surprises at the end.

steps.title: Mobile
steps.text: Your site looks perfect on phones and tablets.
steps.details: Most clients open websites on their phones. So we check every screen on a phone, a tablet and a laptop.

steps.title: Build & launch
steps.text: We write the code, test buttons, forms and speed.
steps.details: We write your site in code — no website builders. We connect the domain, SSL, analytics and forms, check speed and every button. Then we launch.

steps.title: Support
steps.text: A year of warranty and help after launch.
steps.details: For a year after launch we fix bugs for free and help with questions. We show you how to change texts and prices in the admin panel yourself.

stats.title: We are Teamdor studio
stats.text: We build websites, catalogs, online stores and automation, turnkey. A well-tuned process, a fixed price in the contract, and the code and domain are yours.

items.label: the code and domain are yours

contact.title: Open the door — see your website for free
contact.text: Leave your contacts — we'll get back to you within one business day, ask a few questions and show you a prototype in 48–72 hours.
